description: This file defines a 'Log' class for logging messages with different levels (info, warning, error, documentation issues) and supports colored output based on OS. It includes methods for printing, logging, and managing log entries.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logging utility class for managing and outputting log messages with different severity levels and optional colored formatting.

methods.name: __Print
methods.description: Internal method to print text, optionally with a file prefix.

methods.name: InfoLine
methods.description: Logs an informational message with line and file context.

methods.name: WarnLine
methods.description: Logs a warning message with line and file context.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Sets the header for the log, indicating the current file being processed.

methods.name: Ellipsis
methods.description: Shortens a text string with ellipsis, front or back.
